lines.en: Small, but quick on my feet.
My feathers ruffle in the wind.
I walk along the lake shore.
I know these Cretaceous snow woods.
My tail keeps me balanced.
My claws grip wet soil.
Three steps, one pause, always scanning.
I've patrolled this area many times.
All muscle beneath these feathers.
I walk like a big bird.
Three-toed prints in the snow.
I walk close to the shrubs.
I'm liveliest at dawn and dusk.
Being small keeps me careful.
This patch is my territory.
I stare at the lake surface.

lines.zh: 十五点生命，经不起几下
lines.en: Fifteen points of life; not many hits.
My feathers are plain-colored.
There's another animal's scent on the wind.
I glance up at the canopy.
The young ones are nearby.
Guarding the young is instinct.
No large hunters around here.
I'm waiting for dusk.
I rake the ground twice.
I tilt my head, listening hard.
Even the small ones keep watch.
You've crossed my boundary.
Small size, big temper.
My feathers will bristle.
I know what's in your hand.
I don't intend to bite you.
Just stand a bit further off.
I'm guarding the young over there.
Step back and I won't chase.

lines.zh: 我盯着你的脚踝，羽冠竖起。
lines.en: I stare at your ankle, crest raised.
You're too loud.

lines.zh: 我们一起待久了，我会认你
lines.en: Stay long enough and I'll know you.
If you strike, I'll screech.
I shriek and pull back.
A handful of feathers came off.
So light I can barely hold ground.
It hurts, but I won't flee.
I turn and scream at you.
This will heal.
My wing's a bit off.
I took this guarding the nest.
My call went thin.
Strike again and I'll fight for real.
Meat? I am hungry.
That piece is too small.
I'll follow, but keep my distance.
Tear off a bit and toss it.
That smell draws me in.
Reach out and I'll back away.
Set it down, then step back.
I'm not tamed.
This mouthful lasts a while.
You touched my tail feathers.
My bones are light.
One kick could send me flying.
I dodge quickly.
Bump me and I'll shriek.
You're heavy; I can't hold ground.
I hop back half a pace.

lines.zh: 退开，我的领地到此为止。
lines.en: Back off. My territory ends here.
My feathers must be tidy first.
The territory comes first.

lines.zh: 我们这一对，会一起护巢
lines.en: We'd guard the nest together.

lines.zh: 尾巴摆得慢，就是在示好
lines.en: A slow tail sway is a good sign.
A nest by the lake is good.
The young need two adults.
A soft call means yes.
These woods can raise a family.
Don't trample the grass by the nest.
A piece of meat on the ground.
I pin it with a claw.
A feather fell; I pick it up.
I carry it in my jaws.
I tear it small before swallowing.
Is this fresh?
It fell in the snow; took me a while.
I can't linger long.
My claws hold it well.
Carried back toward the nest.
Every feather is up.
I'll screech first, then strike.
You dare come near my nest?
I'm faster than you'd think.
This pounce goes for your feet.
Small, but I bite precisely.
My claws are curved.
Retreat to the lake and you're done.
My sense of territory is strong.
Don't touch that thicket.
One more step and I screech.
This area is mine to guard.
I circle you, hunting a gap.
My call is harsh.
Your ankle is the target.
I lower myself and skim the ground.
My tail turns me fast.
You retreat; I follow.
I can slip into these shrubs.
You can't, but I can.
My prints are in the snow.
I come from the flank.
That low call is mine.
I have more patience than you.
One more turn and your back shows.
I'll wait for you to lift a foot.
You can't outrun me.
I leap and bite your ankle.
My claws rake your shin.
I strike from low.
Feathers flare to make me look bigger.
You flinched and stepped back.
Two bites in a row.
Small teeth, densely set.
This blow is only to drive you off.
If you go, I won't chase.
I glance back at the nest.
Any closer and I won't hold back.
I kick off the ground, claws first.
Wings settling, I stand.

lines.zh: 羽毛上还带着蛋里的湿
lines.en: My feathers still damp from the egg.
I hop down from the nest.
The Cretaceous Yixian stirs.
The snow by the lake hasn't melted.
I know this place's scent.
I stand tall and look around.
I claim these woods.
I emerge in the morning light.
Fifteen points of life; just right.

lines.zh: 羽毛还没干透就出来跑
lines.en: Out running before the feathers dried.
The nest needs guarding.
I come from the snow woods.
Soft soil underfoot.
I shake, feathers lifting.
This territory lay empty.
I take the high spot first.
The lake reflects my shadow.
Small body, loud voice.
Flame makes my feathers curl.
I landed in the snow and rolled.
Water up my snout; I paddle hard.
The blast blew me into the shrubs.
An arrow through my feathers.

lines.zh: 这力量压得我抬不起头
lines.en: This force keeps my head down.
Too little prey; hunger shakes me.
Lightning hit a tree; I panicked.

lines.zh: 没有地面，我抓不到东西
lines.en: No ground; nothing to grip.
